character_lock: Nour is the same four-year-old Arab girl in every image: warm medium skin, large dark-brown friendly eyes, round cheeks, dark-brown hair tied into two short low pigtails with soft cream bands, no headscarf, childlike four-year-old proportions with large head and short limbs. She always wears muted lavender long-sleeve pajamas with tiny cream dots and matching trousers and simple cream slippers. Grandmother is the same gentle Arab woman in her early sixties in every image: warm medium skin, kind dark eyes, softly rounded face, modest light-lavender hijab wrapped identically with no hair visible, long soft sage home dress with lavender cuffs, plain cream indoor shoes, calm closed-mouth expression with no visible teeth. The small cat is the same round fluffy cream cat with soft amber eyes and pink nose, no visible teeth, no sharp eyes, no claws, calm or sleepy expression. Bedroom stays consistent: warm cream walls, low pale-wood child bed with soft bedding, one rounded pale-wood two-pane window, small warm bedside lamp with rounded cream shade clearly visible on every page, no full darkness.
reference_instruction: Preserve the exact Nour, grandmother and cat identities while replacing pose, camera, lighting and scene with the description.
